IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, dark wavy hair
and a soft smile stands on a warm-toned street.
She wears a cream knit top with a high neck and
fitted sleeves, paired with a brown pleated midi skirt
with a wide waistband. A pendant necklace sits at
her throat, and she carries a taupe leather tote at
her side. Warm, natural light, a palette of cream,
chocolate, and taupe. Polished and cozy, in the
style of an autumn street-style look book.
